@@U01320@@
(Aloud.)

@@U01321@@
Good-bye, ladies!

@@U01323@@
Good-bye!

@@U01325@@
Oh, but one thing more, sir!
Tell me, won't you? Quickly?
Is there a witness to when, where and how
my poor darling died,
and where he was buried?
I’m an organized person, you see;
I so like order.
And I would like to read the account
in the weekly journal.

@@U01327@@
Of course, good woman!
The truth demands two witnesses.
I have an excellent companion
I'll take to the judge for you,
then bring him here.

@@U01329@@
Oh, yes, please do!

@@U01331@@
And the young lady?
Will she be here, too?
He’s a fine young man! Well traveled,
and shows every politeness to young ladies.

@@U01333@@
I'd blush just to meet him.

@@U01335@@
Blush?
No king could make you blush, dear child.
translation:
@@U01320@@
（大声）

@@U01321@@
再见，女士们！

@@U01323@@
再见！

@@U01325@@
噢，还有一件事，先生！
告诉我，好吗？迅速地？
是否有见证人何时、何地、如何
我可怜的亲爱的死了，
他被埋在哪里？
你看，我是一个有组织的人；
我太喜欢秩序了
我想阅读该帐户
在周刊上。

@@U01327@@
当然是好女人！
真相需要两个证人。
我有一个优秀的伴侣
我会替你去见法官
然后带他来这里。

@@U01329@@
哦，是的，请这样做！

@@U01331@@
那年轻的女士呢？
她也会在这里吗？
他是一个优秀的年轻人！游历好，
并对年轻女士表现出一切礼貌。

@@U01333@@
光是见到他我就会脸红。

@@U01335@@
脸红？
亲爱的孩子，没有哪个国王能让你脸红。
